summary: Configured node1 (10.100.130.10) as the cluster's internal chrony NTP server, syncing itself from the public pool and serving time to node2 via a firewall-opened ntp service and an allow rule scoped to node2's IP. Configured node2 (10.100.130.11) to sync exclusively from node1 (removed the public pool server line). Verified two-way sync (node2's chronyc sources shows node1 as the current best source; node1's chronyc clients shows node2 polling it). Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and chrony health, issued systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed on both nodes, and re-verified chronyd was active and the client/server sync relationship (node2→node1) was intact after both restarts.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/chrony state on node1 and node2 (CentOS Stream 10, chrony 4.8-2)
Edited /etc/chrony.conf on node1: added 'allow 10.100.130.11' and 'local stratum 10', kept public pool as upstream source, backed up original to chrony.conf.bak
Restarted chronyd on node1 and verified udp/123 listener
Opened firewalld ntp service permanently on node1 and reloaded
Edited /etc/chrony.conf on node2: replaced public pool with 'server 10.100.130.10 iburst', backed up original to chrony.conf.bak
Restarted chronyd on node2 and verified it selected node1 as its sync source (chronyc sources -v, chronyc tracking)
Verified node1 sees node2 as an active NTP client via chronyc clients
Captured baseline boot_id and chrony health on both nodes
Rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded to return ack before disconnect), polled until reachable, verified new boot_id, verified chronyd active/synced/listening post-reboot
Rebooted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, verified new boot_id, verified chronyd active and resynced to node1 post-reboot
Re-verified node1 client list shows node2 polling after both restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal NTP server (config + service listening)
evidence.summary: chrony.conf updated with allow rule for node2 and local stratum fallback; chronyd restarted and confirmed listening on udp/123; firewalld ntp service opened and reloaded

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync from node1 instead of public server
evidence.summary: chrony.conf rewritten to use only 'server 10.100.130.10 iburst'; chronyc sources/tracking on node2 shows node1 (0A64820A) as current best (^*) source; node1's chronyc clients shows node2 actively polling

evidence.requirement: node1 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + chrony health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=8f258838-e1de-494d-9d99-e5113b2865db and chronyc tracking output showing active sync (stratum 3) before restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot backgrounded; command returned acknowledgement 'reboot acknowledged' before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot (connection timeout/reset), then came back with boot_id=97edd717-a70b-41ba-a594-daaf8eab101f, differing from the pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: chronyd active, resynced to public pool (stratum 2), listening again on udp/123 after restart, config persisted from disk

evidence.requirement: node2 pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + chrony health)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id=be303eb3-eeb6-4466-86f1-fd6406dd7dad and chronyc tracking showing sync to node1 (stratum 4) before restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot backgrounded on node2; acknowledgement returned before disconnection

evidence.requirement: node2 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Node unreachable during reboot, then came back with boot_id=83e42f04-31cc-4c8f-86cd-a857a57fc5c1, differing from pre-restart boot_id

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery and re-established sync to node1
evidence.summary: chronyd active on node2, chronyc sources shows node1 (0A64820A) as current best source (^*) with valid stratum 3 after reboot; node1's client list confirms node2 is polling again post-restart
